programme.title: China 24
programme.desc: China 24 is a prime time news program featuring in-depth reports and analysis of the stories in the headlines in China. programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: Made in Italy
programme.desc: (2020) Comedy-drama with Liam Neeson. An estranged father and son team up to fix up and sell an old Tuscan villa that their late wife and mother left to them.

programme.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Applegate River Lodge: In Oregon, Gordon Ramsay tries to rescue the Applegate River Lodge, which is around $1 million in debt. Can he help the owners turn their fortunes around? (S2 Ep3/8) [SL]

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Debarted: Bart gets a new pranking partner. But when his tricks start to backfire, he doesn't know who to trust. (S19 Ep13/20)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Dial 'N' for Nerder: When Homer goes on a diet, Marge gets suspicious and gets a reality TV producer to keep an eye on him. Bart and Lisa play a disastrous trick on Martin. (S19 Ep14/20)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Papa Don't Leech: The Simpsons take in Springfield's biggest tax evader, Lurleen Lumpkin, who's on the run from the police. (S19 Ep16/20)

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Rugby, party queens Soroya and Jodie's unusual pie horrifies super-confident Raj. And estate agent Michael and Caroline search for flaws in Raj and Freddie's 'perfect' relationship.

programme.title: Kirstie's House of Craft
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp makes colourful recycled candles and a fun painted pebble game with her sons, and creates a host of cute feathered friends as she shows us how to make loo roll animals.

programme.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or...
programme.desc: ...List It: Carly and Phil can't agree whether to renovate or sell their four-bed High Wycombe semi. Kirstie has a smart solution but will Phil's tempting alternatives seduce them? (S5 Ep5)

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Another chance to watch Friday's new episode, with Tom Read Wilson in Dictionary Corner. Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: I Kid You Not: Frasier and Lilith practise their parenting skills on Carla's precocious six-year-old son and plan to take him to a fancy restaurant, which annoys Carla. (S7 Ep14/22)

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Don't Paint Your Chickens: Sam dates Erin, an exercise fan who exhausts him with her dedication to athletics and outdoor pursuits. Rebecca promotes Norm's decorating business. (S7 Ep15/22)

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: The Cranemakers: Frasier and a pregnant Lilith reject civilisation and move to the wilderness to enjoy a natural way of life. Woody's forced to take his first holiday in ages. (S7 Ep16/22)

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: The Wedding (Part 1/2): Ray makes the mistake of asking Debra why she married him, rekindling memories of his proposal and his fears that she felt pressured into agreeing. (S2 Ep24)

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: The Wedding (Part 2/2): Ray reminisces about his wedding, when he worried that Debra was more interested in the big day than she was in her groom. (S2 Ep25)

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: The Invasion: Ray moves his family into his parents' house when the termite exterminators visit. And Debra takes the opportunity to turn the tables on her in-laws. (S3 Ep1)

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Maris Returns (Part 1/2): Niles's ex-wife Maris needs his help. Can he keep her return secret from a pregnant and emotional Daphne? (S11 Ep7)

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Murder Most Maris (Part 2/2): Niles is suspected as an accomplice to murder, and Frasier accidentally recommends that his brother should be executed. (S11 Ep8)

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Guns 'N' Neuroses: Lilith and Frasier are both set up on blind dates... on the same day... by a mutual friend. Niles and Daphne are upset when Martin's gun accidentally goes off. (S11 Ep9)

programme.title: Frasier

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Aerial China IV·Xizang
programme.desc: A world-renowned wonderland of snow-capped peaks and river sources, Xizang is also a land of tradition, deep culture and spirituality. However, Xizang also has plenty to boast of in terms of its natural history and wonders. So join us as we fly over the roof of the world to survey the plateau where Tibetan antelopes, wild yaks and people live in harmony!

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, traveling to the cities of Zhuzhou and Xiangtan to meet another group of extraordinary women. By capturing snippets of the lives and work of an electric locomotive designer, a flight instructor, a painter, and a poverty alleviation volunteer, we showcase the unique cultural and humanistic charm of this region.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Aerial China IV·Hong Kong
programme.desc: Hong Kong, a city of skyscrapers positively pulsing with financial energy, the legendary Pearl of the Orient. But there’s another side to that great city - the nighttime romance of Victoria Harbour, islands frozen in time for hundreds of millions of years, a metropolis constantly changing and transforming itself. Join us for the ultimate bird’s eyes of Hong Kong!

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, traveling to the cities of Zhuzhou and Xiangtan to meet another group of extraordinary women. By capturing snippets of the lives and work of an electric locomotive designer, a flight instructor, a painter, and a poverty alleviation volunteer, we showcase the unique cultural and humanistic charm of this region.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 1
programme.desc: Nanjing, an ancient city that served as the capital of six imperial dynasties, stands as a testament to China's long-standing history and rich culture. From its Porcelain Tower - one of the Seven Wonders of the Middle Ages, to its grand city walls and ancient palaces, join us on a voyage across time to experience the echoes of history in Nanjing's storied bricks.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 2
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the grand old mansions of Nanjing’s merchant families and take a stroll through their exquisite gardens, where Nature is incorporated into the architecture. From centuries-old Qing Dynasty residences to traditional folk handicrafts, join us on a deep dive into Nanjing’s rich cultural heritage.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: 2026 Spring Festival Gala Promo
programme.desc: China Media Group (CMG), the country's flagship broadcaster, has released a short video promoting its annual Spring Festival Gala, which will be broadcast live around the world on the evening of February 16.

programme.title: Aerial China IV·Taiwan
programme.desc: Lying on the continental shelf off southeast China, just across a shallow strait from Fujian, lies China’s largest island: Taiwan. On this adventure, we take wing across the Taiwan Strait to explore a long-celebrated archipelago and trace ancestral footsteps all the way to a ceremony that has persisted for over three centuries….

programme.title: Jingmai Wanderings: A Symphony of Humans and Tea
programme.desc: As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Mount Jingmai embodies the ecological wisdom of forest–tea symbiosis and the rich cultural diversity of its ethnic communities. It plays a vital role in biodiversity conservation and the preservation of traditional tea culture. This episode follows the stories of representative individuals to explore three key themes — heritage preservation, ecological sustainability, and youth empowerment — revealing the unique charm and sustainable development model of Mount Jingmai.

programme.title: Suzhou Fans
programme.desc: Suzhou, known as the “Venice of China,” is also famous for its traditional crafts. And one of the most elegant and exquisite crafts is Suzhou fans. Celebrated for their exquisite design and fine quality, they’re popularly associated with literati. How come Suzhou gave birth to such a variety of fans? How can we appreciate their beauty in the modern world? In this episode, we are discovering more stories behind Suzhou fans.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.desc: Top secret recipes from Korean master chefs!

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Race to the Rock
programme.desc: The Race to the Rock is an annual unsupported ultra-distance bicycle race through the Australian Outback organized by Jesse Carlsson. Unlike stage races, such as the Tour De France, ultra-distance races start and run continuously until the competitors finish the race, forcing them to make such strategic choices as whether it would be better to take time to eat or sleep, or to sacrifice those things and press on. Race to the Rock is an unsupported race, which means that racers are not permitted to draft or to obtain help from anything other than publicly available sources that are available for all. The course varies every year, but finishes at Uluru, also known as Ayers Rock, and has been so gruelling that only a very small percentage of the competitors have ever finished the race. Roads are mostly unsealed, with limited water supplies, and stretches of 400-500 kilometres at times with no food resupply available.

programme.desc: In a world where limits are defined by sight, one man dares to see beyond. Gerrard Gosens â totally blind adventurer, Paralympian, Everest summiteer, and recipient of the Order of Australia Medal â sets his sights on a challenge no (totally Blind from Birth) human has ever completed: conquering the 20 Bridges circumnavigation of Manhattan Island. Battling currents, cold, and crushing fatigue, Gerrard and his team must navigate one of the most iconic open water swims on the planet, at night. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the clubâs flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.desc: (Ser : Spanish for Being)Ski mountaineering champion Mireia Miro quickly looks back on her athletic career and explains how she gives life meaning beyond her sporting victories. For her, what defines us is simply Being. To escape the pressure of competition, find a balance and reconnect with nature and the world, each year she goes on a trip. We find her in Tromso in Norway where she practices ski mountaineering just for fun in breathtaking natural spaces at the limit of the sea and the mountains. Friendship, Pleasure, Ski Mountaineering, Adventure and Nature are the ingredients of this film.

programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise Â£100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Raid Gallaecia 2025
programme.desc: In the frontier between Galicia and northern Portugal, adventure racing returned to one of Europeâs most unspoiled regions with Raid Gallaecia 2025. Over five days and nearly 500 kilometers, 28 international teams battled mountains, forests, rivers, and exhaustion in a non-stop race of strategy, endurance, and teamwork.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race â itâs a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling â every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection â with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: Ultra Vegans
programme.desc: For endurance athletes, getting the right diet can make the difference between success and failure. Many are now choosing to adopt a plant based regime and they are witnessing some remarkable results in terms of performance and recovery. Athletes, fitness coaches, sports nutritionists, ultra runners are sharing with us their experience and conviction wether they are motivated by self performance or animal wellfare.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: New Zealand 9
programme.desc: In a race against time, three adventurers will set a new speed record by completing New Zealandâs nine Great Walks faster than theyâve ever been done before, using human power alone. Itâs the ultimate adventure race. Theyâll kayak 145 km, ride 80 km and run over 300 km in just nine days.

programme.desc: Emma Keeling treks through Romania’s Tarcu Mountains to see how European bison, once extinct in the wild, are making a comeback.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - ""The Way" to Fusion"
programme.desc: Neil Cairns visits ITER in France, where nuclear fusion could provide unlimited clean energy, to see progress and challenges firsthand.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1 - "Urban Microbiome"
programme.desc: Research shows sanitized cities reduce beneficial microbes, harming health and increasing allergies and autoimmune diseases.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Rob Innes"
programme.desc: Rob Innes’ meticulous engineering and extensive testing have resulted in a very safe and stable watercraft : The Seabreacher.

programme.title: Past, Present, Future S1 - "...of Surgery"
programme.desc: Hundreds of years before antibiotics, the legendary Chinese physician Hua Tuo performed miraculous surgical operations. Today, doctors perform increasingly complex surgery that is only possible with the support of advanced robotics.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "The Senses"
programme.desc: Jack meets people with synaesthesia and experiences multisensory gastronomy.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Pain & Fear"
programme.desc: Wim Hof teaches Jack how to control his pain and plunge into the ice cold sea.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Creativity"
programme.desc: Jack meets a man with Sudden Artistic Output syndrome and unleashes his creativity.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Sleep"
programme.desc: Jack meets two people who can’t stop falling asleep and finds out the consequences of sleep deprivation

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "Chopsticks, Coffee and Coins"
programme.desc: Find our about chopsticks, coffee, coins, cooking and cotton, in this exciting episode that also explores the various Dinosaurs and what it’s like to feel and prepare for an Earthquake

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "What do Karate, and Kick Boxing have in common?"
programme.sub-title: What do Karate, and Kick Boxing have in common?
programme.desc: Be more curious about the science of fossils and explore what’s on offer at the modern and popular gyms. What exactly is Induction Cooking and what do Karate, and Kick Boxing have in common?

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "What is the Moon made of?"
programme.sub-title: What is the Moon made of?
programme.desc: What is milk? What is the Moon made of? How are Pencil’s made? Plus Roller Coasters, Rulers, Sail Boats, Snakes and more in this episode of More Curious

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "Eerie sounds of a Violin"
programme.desc: Find out more about yacht’s, the seasons and sushi, plus explore the martial art of Taekwondo. Take a look at the devastation left in the wake of a Tsunami, and the playful and eerie sounds of a Violin.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "LIKE BUTTON"
programme.desc: When first presented with the like button Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg had a simple response: “No.” He worried that it would discourage more meaningful online interaction. Eventually, his team changed his mind and transformed the world.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "CUBICLE"
programme.desc: A futuristic designer, Robert Propst, dreamed up “The Action Office” as a workplace utopia that would unleash the modern knowledge worker’s vast untapped potential.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "BARCODE"
programme.desc: Barcodes have radically changed global commerce, helping fuel the rise of everything from massive companies like Walmart to world powers like China. And it all started with a man daydreaming on a beach in 1949.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "FLORIDA"
programme.desc: Florida wasn’t always the Sunshine State. In the 1920s, an army of real estate boosters set out to redefine Florida from an economic backwater to a vacation destination, sparking a land boom–and bust–the likes of which America had never seen before.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Elephant Cave"
programme.desc: Possibly the home of the deadly Marberg Ebola virus, Kitum Cave is high on Mt.Elgon straddling the Kenya-Uganda border. When host George Kourounis gets bitten by one of the bats…well, you’ll have to see the show to find out what happens.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Eco-Disasters"
programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Costa Rica"
programme.desc: George explores the volcanoes of Costa Rica with an international team of scientists, rafts down whitewater rivers in full flood, canyoneers down raging waterfalls, and handles some of deadliest snakes this tropical country has to offer.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Antarctica"
programme.desc: George returns to “Fin Del Mundo” at the southern tip of Argentina. After braving the stormy Drake passage, he explores volcanic Deception Island, camps out in the Antarctic snow, and paddles a kayak through icebergs calved off the melting glaciers.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Fusion: Harnessing the Power of Stars"
programme.sub-title: Fusion: Harnessing the Power of Stars
programme.desc: Humanity is closer than ever before to a perpetual clean power source after a team of scientists at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory successfully produced a nuclear fusion reaction resulting in a net energy gain.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "The Great Seaweed Invasion"
programme.desc: A giant mass of floating seaweed is invading popular beaches in the US and Caribbean! At sea, the sargassum belt is a floating ecosystem, but when it hits shore it turns toxic.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "ECHO: The Penguin's Bodyguard"
programme.desc: In Antarctica, ECHO - a state-of-the-art robotic penguin - uses remote sensing technology to monitor these now-endangered penguin colonies.

programme.title: Science of Sound S1 - "Sticky Lyrics"
programme.desc: Have you ever gotten a song stuck in your head? Marty Music sat down with Dr. Carole Scherling, a neuroscientist from Belmont University, to talk all about sticky lyrics and the science behind why some catchy tunes get stuck in our heads.

programme.title: Science of Sound S1 - "Power of Nostalgia"
programme.desc: Music has the power to transport us back in time. Marty Music sat down with Nicole Richard, a neurologic music therapist, and professor from Belmont University to talk about how music affects our brains and stirs up memories.

programme.title: Science of Sound S1 - "Imagination Soundtrack"
programme.desc: Professional athletes use music to get psyched up for a big game. But why does music have the power to inspire, motivate, and make us cry? Marty Music finds out how music makes us move.

programme.title: Science of Sound S1 - "Live Music Vibes"
programme.desc: It’s easy to love live music. Whether you’re jamming with some friends or you’re lost in the crowd at an amazing show, live music really moves us. But why does it feel so much better than listening to music on the best home stereo?

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Psychological"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four theme park rides in Europe and America which use psychological tricks to add to the thrills.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Fun"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell investigates four theme park rides in Europe and America which mix fun along with the the thrills.

programme.title: Science of Thrills S1 - "Design"
programme.desc: Engineer and adventurer Rob Bell finds out what it takes to design and build the next generation of rollercoasters.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Kashmir Powder Keg"
programme.desc: With Kashmir’s special status removed in early August 2019 and terrorist attacks plaguing the region since earlier in the year, the India/Pakistani border-conflict has escalated once more.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Secret War In Laos"
programme.desc: In efforts to remove the Communists, the US conducted a devastating military operation, making Laos the most bombed country per capita - ever. The Laos Civil War has often been called America’s “secret war.”

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Cold War In Central America"
programme.desc: In the 1980s, El Salvador and Nicaragua were fighting vicious civil wars that claimed killed at least 100,000, saw 8000 people disappear, and left hundreds of thousands displaced. Still spearheading a global fight against communism, the US engaged.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Cold War In Central America"
programme.desc: In the 1980s, El Salvador and Nicaragua were fighting vicious civil wars that claimed killed at least 100,000, saw 8000 people disappear, and left hundreds of thousands displaced. Still spearheading a global fight against communism, the US engaged.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Desert War In Mali"
programme.desc: It is a deadly war in the desert, one we know barely anything about. Once the heart of the golden Mali Empire, home to the richest man of the 14th century, the northern town of Timbuktu has become the victim of political instability and terror.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"
programme.desc: Artillery, the King of Battle, is explored as gunners train with powerful weapons and prepare for modern combat deployment.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "First Ten Combat Missions"
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War, the USAF learned most pilot losses happened in their first 10 missions, leading to intense training that saves lives.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hoxha's Bunker Madness"
programme.desc: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "From The Lab To The Field"
programme.sub-title: From The Lab To The Field
programme.desc: From the laboratory to Africa, Dr Sheila Ochugboju takes her scientific knowledge to Kenya turning parasitic problems into scientific solutions.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Dolphin Sanctuary"
programme.desc: Anastasia Miliou and her team of women scientist are building a sanctuary in Greece for dolphins released from captivity, the first of its kind.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "RoboGal (AKA Queen of Robots)"
programme.desc: One of the world’s leading tech developers is creating a new generation of robots designed to help people with everyday tasks.

programme.title: The New Frontier S3 - "Living in Space"
programme.desc: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.

programme.title: The New Frontier S3 - "Atmosphere"
programme.desc: Climate change and pollution are having dire consequences for the atmosphere of our planet, this episode updates the latest technology and science looking into the health of our air.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Record Day - Part 1"
programme.desc: The transformation is complete and it’s time for The Flying Kestrel to be put to the test.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "WWII Pilot Training - T-6"
programme.desc: Kurtis earn his wings in a T-6 warbird at Stallion 51 Flight Operations in Kissimmee, FL!

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "WWII Training - P-51"
programme.desc: Kurtis takes you back in time to see what it was like for young WWII pilots fly in the legendary fighter, the P-51 Mustang.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Winter Flying"
programme.desc: Anthony shows us the different methods to keep yourself and your plane warmed up in those cold winter months.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "Night Time Flying"
programme.desc: Kurtis and Anthony take us night flying. Some say it's more beautiful... while others think it's more dangerous!

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S1 - "Flying Machine"
programme.desc: Join Re-Inventors Matt and Jeremy as they take this pedal-powered ancestor to the helicopter on a test flight.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S1 - "Flying Car"
programme.desc: See if a little wishful thinking and a lot of hard pedaling can get a 19th Century flying invention off the ground.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S1 - "Incinerating Toilet"
programme.desc: Is it goof idea to blow up the toilet? Watch this episode to find out.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Da Vinci Gun"
programme.desc: Da Vinci, an artist who also made a machine gun. We will see if it was usable or not.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Asteroid or Alien Tech?"
programme.desc: It was discovered on October 19th, 2017 and it was recognized as the first known object of its type. It is unique since it is the first known object that came from our solar system. But while we observed it, the mystery surrounding it grew.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Ketamine: From Street Drug to Lifesaver"
programme.sub-title: Ketamine: From Street Drug to Lifesaver
programme.desc: Worldwide, depression afflicts more than 300 million people, making it the leading global cause of disability. Suicide is the 2nd leading cause of death in the world for those aged 15-24 years. Now there may be a new tool in fighting that depression.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Saving Venice"
programme.desc: MOSE is one of the largest and highest-profile civil-engineering works. But will it be able to save Venice? Venice has grappled with inundation for centuries.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Hacking our Microbiome"
programme.desc: Every person is playing host to at least 40 trillion non-human microorganisms. Collectively, these microbes constitute what's called our microbiome.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Saving Private Terry"
programme.desc: Terry gets to relive part of his military carrier by attempting the famous sniper shot from Saving Private Ryan, and Larry and Terry demonstrate how sniper technology has developed over the years and test some amazing sniper shots.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry"
programme.sub-title: The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry
programme.desc: Terry channels his inner Dr. Jones and tests 1 scene from Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade containing 3 different tests, two of which they will need a tank for. The duo will travel down to Uvalde, TX to visit Drivetanks.com to see if a tank round will topple over a car, and if a 9mm round can travel through three Germans.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Equalizing Terry"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry will test 3 scenes from Denzel Washington’s Equalizer films. Can Terry be as cool as Denzel and use propane tanks and a microwave to create an explosion, use a staple gun to take out the bad guy, or create a scenario where a flash bang will ignite a room full of baking flour?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Silencing Terry"
programme.desc: Terry wants to demonstrate how Hollywood has used different objects to silence a gunshot, and he and Larry will take to the range to see which one is the most qualified to act as a silencer. Terry also has a sit-down with Joey Zasa from Godfather 3 (Joe Mantegna) to discuss what he thinks of Hollywood’s adaptation of the silencer.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 1"
programme.desc: In Lima, the capital of Peru which has been plagued by malnutrition, the future of food and farming is being reinvented as top chefs believe gastronomy can achieve social justice.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 2"
programme.desc: Kanyan farmer and campaigner Moses Shaha is sceptical of biofuel. He journeys through southern Kenya, where farmers are starting to grow jatropha, to understand if the biofuel crop is a threat to farmland and food securuty as he fears.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: Exploring whether big agribusiness or small scale farmers are better placed to feed the world.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 4"
programme.desc: In India, Tulika Verma is on a mission to ban junk food from Delhi's Schools, where one in six school children is overweight. India faces two possible futures: one healthy, and one a future of 'Western-style' diets and an epidemic of obesity.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: Nigerian Minister of Agriculture Akinwunmi Ayo Adesina believes it is his job to ensure Nigerians eat food grown in Nigeria, and he's determined to overcome the obstacles to Nigerian self-sufficiency in food production.

programme.title: Future Food S1 - "Episode 6"
programme.desc: Shanghai-based social media agency Resonance apply their branding skills to convince young Chinese that farming could be a viable career choice.

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "World’s Most Used Medications"
programme.desc: Ultimate is a game more commonly known as Frisbee, we’ll take a look at one of the world’s most used medications, Asprin as well as the Cello, Tattoo’s, Tea, Thanksgiving and Recycling.

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "3D Printing Technology and Cloud Storage"
programme.desc: Take a deep dive into 3D Printing technology and Cloud Storage. Discover all there is to know about Trains, Mammals, what is an aerosol spray plus signs ad treatments of the Common Cold

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "What Makes a Storm?"
programme.desc: Take a look at the many woodwind instruments, explore the benefits of tablet computers, plus find out what makes a storm! We cover the history of speakers, rubbing alcohol and find out about the planets.

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "What are the many functions of our Nose?"
programme.sub-title: What are the many functions of our Nose?
programme.desc: Bass describes musical instruments with a low or deep frequency, passports are essential for global travel and what are the many functions of our Nose? Other topics covered include Blood pressure, Cinema, Pop and Comics.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "MAUVE"
programme.desc: In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue -- the world’s first synthetic dye. In just a few years, ‘Mauve’ would take over the fashion industry and enable stunning advances in medicine.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "VANILLA"
programme.desc: In 1841 on the small island of Réunion, a 12-year-old slave did something no one had done before; artificially pollinate the vanilla plant. The vanilla bean took the world by storm, sparking the artificial flavor revolution and changing how we eat.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Megafloods"
programme.desc: Witness the devastating destructive power unleashed by planet earth’s most valuable resource – water.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Constructions"
programme.desc: Discover the worst bridge collapses and tunnel fires in history.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Hurricanes"
programme.desc: Explore with us one of the most destructive and deadliest hurricanes in history!

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Arctic Winter"
programme.desc: George links up with two experienced polar adventurers in the frigid Canadian arctic in the depths of winter. First uses skis to cross the fractured sea ice of Frobisher Bay, then dog teams to head north through the spectacular Auyuittuq Mountains.

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Polynesian Volcanoes"
programme.desc: Filming the volcanoes, mudpools and geysers in the geothermic wonderland of New Zealand’s north island, we learn that a new island is being created by an undersea volcano 1000 miles north in Tonga

programme.title: Angry Planet S3 - "Highway to Hell"
programme.desc: George heads straight into the “Bearcage”, looking to get beat up by the biggest, baddest hailstones that Texas and Oklahoma can throw at them. He finds it –and the stormchasing vehicles don’t look too pretty after coming through these massive storms

programme.desc: En steward skal håndtere en passager, som ikke vil spænde selen, britiske opdagelsesrejsende diskuterer deres rejser, to par forsøger at undgå spoilers på en dobbeltdate og en bibelgruppe oplever en guddommelig intervention.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Pussy On The Chainwax
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Keegan, der bliver distraheret, mens han taler i telefon med sin kæreste, Keegan og Jordan har en ond chef og tilblivelsen af et nyt udtryk.

programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan diskuterer, hvem der er mest sort og når man er den eneste sorte fyr til en fest. Sketches inkluderer Tea Party, der opdager et nyt håb, hærens hververe, der tænker anderledes, og Bobby McFerrin, der dyster mod Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dubstep
programme.desc: Præsident Obama og hans vredesoversætter, Luther, taler til Mitt Romney, vi møder manden, der skulle tale efter Martin Luther Kings 'I Have A Dream'-tale, og to venner taler om, hvad der sker med deres bæ, efter de skyller ud.

programme.desc: En baseballspiller kæmper mod sin afhængighed af at klaske røv, en mafioso tager hævn og Steve Urkel driver en mand til vanvid.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Scariest Movie Ever
programme.desc: A vampyr afslører sig selv, en seriemorder bliver bremset og et barn får sit ønske opfyldt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Landlord
programme.desc: I sæsonfinalen vil præsident Obama behandles ligesom alle andre, Jordan ser på en lejlighed, som er ejet af en mistænksom vicevært og et par festaber, der vil få gang i festen til en bar mitzvah.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Obama College Years
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan befinder sig pludselig i en genopførsel af Borgerkrigen, Jesus møder en farlig alfons, og vi får set præsident Barack Obama de første år på college.

programme.desc: Artister bliver sparket i skridtet på grund af deres kunst, klassens klovn terroriserer læreren og en mand prøver at få heldet med sig til et møde for sexmisbrugere.

programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan fejrer Halloween ved at flygte fra racistiske zombier, skuespillerne i 'Human Centipede' har en skræmmende genforening, og vi besøger en folkeskole for troldmænd med problemer.

programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan udforsker oplevelsen som sort collegestuderende og snyltegæster, som succes medfører. Andre sketches inkluderer et kvartes reaktion på et mystisk væsen, hvornår man kan - og ikke kan - sige et kontroversielt ord.

programme.desc: En fodboldspiller med hjerneskade prøver at inspirere sit hold, en mand anklager sin kone for at være utro med en hund og en restaurantejer skræmmer sine gæster væk.

programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Majestic View Created by the Nature, Jeju
programme.desc: The natural environment of deep blue sea and steep cliffs under the azure sky makes a majestic view around the island of Jeju. The lava flowed from the volcano of the island created a spectacular landscape in corners of Jeju such as Seongsan Ilchulbong Peak and pillar-shaped cliffs on the coast. The heavenly combination between the sky, the ocean and the bold cliffs by the shore. Here, we present the mysterious land of Jeju.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Island of Wind and Stones
programme.desc: Experience a day in Seongeup Folk Village of Jeju, the island of wind and stones. Jeju has long been referred to samdado (island of three many) because it is abundant with wind, stones and women. The thatched houses in Jeju were wisely constructed with stones as soil is not sufficient, and in a way to embrace strong winds.

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water

programme.title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : Seoguipo Soesokkak Estuary, the mysterious landscape created by lava and water
programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The landscape of Jeju Island from which you are able to sees Mt. Sanbang

programme.sub-title: An island where the wind stays. Jeju : The Coast of Yongmeori, Jeju Which the Volcanic Piled Over and the Waves Cut
programme.desc: When a volcanic erupted here in the shallow sea 1.8 million years ago, the fragmental matters spewed and piled up one by one neatly. programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: This episode portrays the golden jackal – a shy predator, whose territory used to be the Balkan and even further southern regions. The animals are spreading north until Hungary or Germany and scientists are on their footstep, to find out why.

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: This episode is about on the most ancient and majestic animal of the continent: the muskox seems like the last survivor of the ice age – and it is. Thousands of years ago the animals roamed our landscapes together with mammoths. Nowadays, the only remaining herds live in Scandinavia: the Dovrefjell National Park in Norway and the Härjedaalen area in Sweden - where scientists and environmentalists put up a breeding centre in order to protect and strengthen the wild population of muskox - are the main locations of this episode.

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: This episode introduces a rare inhabitant of the mediterranean mountains: The mouflon sheep origin in Corsica and Sardinia, as well as on Cyprus.

programme.title: Frontier Vets
programme.desc: Delarey drives through first thing in the morning to the Kruger Park to take slides to an Anthrax expert. Is it Anthrax?

programme.title: Frontier Vets
programme.desc: There is much confusion as to where the rhino has fallen. The vehicle carrying the experienced vet breaks down. Dr. Greg is delayed and unable to reach the rhino. How will the students manage without him and the more experienced team?

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters
programme.desc: The safari continues at Kavinga where Kristina and Andy have more interactions with Juno, the resident lion king. A late drive leads them to the predators of the night. They come across a lion eating a porcupine and Morgan the elephant decides to join them at the bar with a weakness for lemons!

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters
programme.desc: Kristina is back with Sean and hosted at the Hide Safari Camp in Hwange National Park at their driest period. A night drive leads them to a unique finding. They discover an unexpected leopard kill and spend time with a hungry pride as they study the menu. Find out if the lion's order comes through.

programme.title: Dhamaal
programme.desc: Dhamaal is a madcap comedy about four lazy and broke friends who accidentally learn about a hidden treasure buried in Goa. What follows is a hilarious adventure filled with unexpected twists, car chases, and laugh-out-loud moments as they race against others to find the fortune. Directed by Indra Kumar, this film is known for its clean humor and slapstick fun, making it a cult classic in Indian comedy.

The film is an uncredited remake of the South Korean movie A Bittersweet Life.
